reviewScope: One-round local closeout, isolated protocol tests, ledger/evidence staging boundaries, retrospective A pointer; commit has not occurred and remains controller work.

frozenReview.assembly: Only a temporary source copy changes PORT to 0 and binds loopback with a readiness message; original relative asset location resolves within isolated temporary input. No original checkout or live Desktop write is in the new tests.
frozenReview.commandAccounting: 16 original names = 3 direct common commands + 2 direct executions replacing queued bridge mode + 11 unsupported names. Current support is 5/16, not 6/17. Additional workspace/presentation commands and UI aliases listed separately.
frozenReview.semanticLimits: Tests explicitly retain auth, validation/revision, duplicate-ID, command-queue, SSE framing/cursor and cold-reset differences. This is no full equivalence claim.

stagingAtReview.limits: Filename and selected high-confidence pattern audit plus indexed hashes, not an absolute proof that all possible secrets are absent; historical public source was checked through hashes and key prior receipts, not reread line by line.

attributes: core.autocrlf=true. Root * -text preserves SHA-addressed bytes; fixture override text eol=lf explicitly retains original LF Git blob. Indexed stage bytes match recorded hashes.
retrospectiveAReceipt: ../../20261022-desktop-compat/checker/a-final-review.json explicitly says written after runtime acceptance and distinguishes historical A33, independent Desktop Gate34 and current38.
handoffBeforeCommit: Controller must refresh evidence/INDEX.json and stage this round's new Checker/A pointer files, then run the planned final batch staging audit. Commit-specific commit.json and receipt remain ignored local attestations anchored to full HEAD; no recursive second commit.
authorization: One local commit only, then stop. No push, merge, next card, model call or Desktop start/stop. Per-command commit metadata may reuse existing canonical project config; no global identity change or account switch.
excluded: Actual commit success until controller records resulting HEAD
